summary: Completed backend testing of Simples Nacional DAS calculation fix. The bug where DAS was showing R$ 0.00 has been FIXED. The endpoint POST /api/dashboard/simples-nacional now correctly returns valor_das_final = R$ 6.173,67 for company E.L.M. COMERCIO DE ALIMENTOS LTDA in competência 01/2026.
passed_tests: valor_das_final is greater than zero when there's revenue (R$ 6.173,67)
DAS response structure is complete with all required fields
Descontos structure contains icms_st, pis_cofins_monofasico, total, produtos_st, produtos_monofasicos, produtos_aliquota_zero
ICMS-ST discount (R$ 1.960,62) is proportional to alíquota efetiva (8.73%)
PIS/COFINS monofásico discount (R$ 728,19) is calculated correctly
Total discounts (R$ 2.688,81) do not exceed DAS bruto (R$ 8.862,47)
DAS final = DAS bruto - total descontos (R$ 8.862,47 - R$ 2.688,81 = R$ 6.173,67)
Repartição dos tributos (IRPJ, CSLL, COFINS, PIS, CPP, ICMS) is returned correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix verified: DAS calculation now uses correct formula for discounts
Discount formula: desconto = valor_produtos × alíquota_efetiva × (% tributo na repartição / 100)
Protection added: discounts cannot exceed DAS bruto value
Code in /app/backend/services/simples_nacional_calculator.py function calcular_das_periodo is correct
seed_data_creation: Used existing company E. L. M. COMERCIO DE ALIMENTOS LTDA (ID: e33af37a-38c3-41cb-a786-f8a685c860f6) with competência 01/2026
context_for_next_testing_agent: DAS calculation bug has been fixed and verified. The endpoint POST /api/dashboard/simples-nacional correctly calculates valor_das_final with proper discounts for ICMS-ST and PIS/COFINS monofásico/alíquota zero products. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_simples_nacional_das.py for regression testing.

bug_fix_verification.bug_description: DAS value was showing R$ 0.00 even with revenue because discounts were calculated incorrectly
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Discounts were applying percentage of repartição directly to product values instead of applying alíquota efetiva proportionally
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Discounts now calculated as: valor_produtos × alíquota_efetiva × (% tributo na repartição / 100)
bug_fix_verification.expected_result: valor_das_final ≈ R$ 6.173,67 for E.L.M. company in 01/2026
